conflicts.detail: pair_walkforward_outcome lacks official a_bonus_assisted_triple and b_bonus_assisted_triple columns required by v2.7.4 chapters 2 and 18

pair_rule_signature requires pair rule risk, recent support state, structure context and bonus dependence; those values require prior selection exposures grouped by pair_rule_signature. The official rule does not define the initial/transition lookup key or a deterministic fixed-point rule, so implementing one would add an unapproved research rule.
